decision.reason: In the prespecified six-process screen the candidate is slower in complete decode and continuous session; ranges do not overlap and every paired direction is slower. Close this attempt without more samples or tuning.
decision.attribution: Emitted IDs and aggregate exported work are identical, but local natural MTP decisions/draft work differ. Do not attribute the measured regression solely to the kernel, host overhead or acceptance rate.

scope.selection: Only ordinary rank2 BF16 ports/F32 accumulation with original transposed compact W view; shape/device choice lives in one private native selector. No model or layer IDs.
scope.experiment: Scratch overlay only; original M1, other descriptors/devices, global MMVF selector and non-GGML default preferences retained.

protocol.limits: Natural greedy/EOS, one load and resident session per process. Original top-level continuous P+D=session endpoints; nested turn spans are explanatory. Not a formal replacement four-arm window.

work.IDs_and_all_rounds: Retained verbatim in archived screen1/runs.json and each original stdout log.

build.initial_scope_correction: An initial prepared-only policy honored every provider finite preference. Before any build it was restricted to GGML refinement only; other providers retain original99/rank+Graph offset. Exact earlier metadata/source/commands remain archived under before-policy-scope-fix.

finite_functional_smoke.limit: Two turns of<=4 outputs; limited continuity only, not task quality or timing.

process.purpose: Confirm whole-M2 typed MMVF actually executes in finite two-turn consumer; not a performance window.

queries.sql: SELECT k.graphId,k.correlationId,COUNT(*) AS kernels,SUM(s.value LIKE ?) AS typed_m2 FROM CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_KERNEL k JOIN StringIds s ON s.id=k.demangledName WHERE k.graphId IS NOT NULL GROUP BY k.graphId,k.correlationId HAVING typed_m2>0 ORDER BY k.graphId
SELECT copyKind,COUNT(*),SUM(bytes) FROM CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_MEMCPY WHERE correlationId=? GROUP BY copyKind

structural_trace.limit: Trace smoke used profiling and overlapped static HTTP; only structural execution/copy counts. These times are not part of the six-process quiet screen. Original SQLite included; redundant nsys-rep omitted.

archive.contents: Necessary overlay7sources/patch, thin scripts, actual5compile+link metadata/logs, six-run source observations/logs, finite functional smoke, original trace SQLite, prepared-before-scope-correction metadata and reused-consumer metadata. No W/A bodies, SDK, objects, executables, nsys-rep or full reused closure.
